records.label: Edit an existing post type (Posts, Pages, Media or one registered by a theme or plugin such as WooCommerce products)
records.notes: JetEngine "Edit built-in post types and taxonomies" (https://crocoblock.com/knowledge-base/jetengine/); Toolset Types and ACPT edit built-in and third-party post types and taxonomies. Stored as an override of the registered object (register_post_type_args / register_taxonomy_args), never as a new registration; reverting removes the override and restores the original arguments. Hooks: register_post_type_args (https://developer.wordpress.org/reference/hooks/register_post_type_args/).

records.label: Rename an existing post type and change its menu icon and menu position
records.notes: JetEngine "Edit built-in post types and taxonomies" (https://crocoblock.com/knowledge-base/jetengine/). Labels and menu args via register_post_type_args. Stored as an override of the registered object (register_post_type_args / register_taxonomy_args), never as a new registration; reverting removes the override and restores the original arguments.

records.label: Add or remove editor features of an existing post type (comments, excerpt, author, thumbnail, revisions, custom fields, page attributes)
records.notes: add_post_type_support() / remove_post_type_support() (https://developer.wordpress.org/reference/functions/remove_post_type_support/). Removing comments from Posts and Pages is the most requested case.

records.label: Change visibility and URLs of an existing post type (public, show in menu, archive, rewrite slug, REST exposure, search exclusion)
records.notes: JetEngine "Edit built-in post types and taxonomies" (https://crocoblock.com/knowledge-base/jetengine/); register_post_type_args. Slug changes go through the rewrite refresh and redirect preview. Stored as an override of the registered object (register_post_type_args / register_taxonomy_args), never as a new registration; reverting removes the override and restores the original arguments.

records.label: Hide or disable a built-in post type (for example Posts on a site that only uses Pages) with content kept
records.notes: Market: "Disable Posts" style plugins and Admin Menu Editor. Hides menu, admin bar "New" item, Gutenberg and REST access; never deletes existing posts.

records.label: Revert an existing post type to its original registration and show what is overridden
records.notes: Every override shows the original value next to the new one and can be reverted per setting or all at once.

records.label: Unregistering core post types (post, page, attachment, revision, nav_menu_item, wp_block, wp_template)
records.notes: Rejected: core and the block editor depend on these; unregister_post_type() on them breaks menus, revisions and Site Editor. Use existing.disable instead.

coverage.notes: Gap closure 2026-11-20: editing, hiding and reverting objects WordPress, themes or other plugins already register.
